column1: # Community word list for Pyaw — add words people type that Pyaw gets wrong.
# One per line: what you type <TAB> the Burmese [<TAB> cost, optional: lower = stronger, default 0.3]
# Spaces in the Myanglish are ignored, so "kya naw" and "kyanaw" are the same entry.
# Only add spellings real people use; test with:  .build/release/pyaw-cli "your phrase"
